scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml; pnpm -r exec rm -rf node_modules dist
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:playground
scripts.build:packages: pnpm run clean:packages; pnpm -F './packages/**' run build
scripts.publish:latest: pnpm install; pnpm build; changeset publish
scripts.publish:alpha: pnpm install; pnpm build; changeset publish --tag alpha
scripts.publish:beta: pnpm install; pnpm build; changeset publish --tag beta
scripts.publish:canary: pnpm install; pnpm build; changeset publish --tag canary
